pages.title: 01 // THE B2B CONVERSION WALL
pages.content:
You want to sell complex B2B products: Robotics arms, Physical AI nodes, Industrial hardware. So you build a website, upload static PNG renders, write marketing text, and add a 'Request a Demo' button.

Nobody clicks. Static images don't build trust; they look like wallpaper. Prospects want to touch the machine, dismantle components, and configure specs in real time.

pages.title: 02 // THE $0 GPU RENDER ARCHITECTURE
pages.content:
How do you build a custom 3D Web App for every client?
Option A: Hire five Three.js developers and spend three months per build.
Option B: Spin up heavy GPU server clusters that charge $5 per render.
Option C: Build the Studio Configurator Engine.

Emit a lightweight JSON AST payload, validate through a Zod client gate, and stream directly into the browser.

pages.title: 03 // ZERO SERVER RENDER FEE & INSTANT STREAM
pages.content: The backend returns a clean HTML/GSAP/Three.js stream. The browser feeds it directly to an in-memory iframe (srcdoc). Client-side GPU renders at 60FPS. Server compute cost: $0.00. Latency: Under 500ms.
